causal_reference.supported_cause: Replica R2 serves a prior row version because its replication position trails the committed primary version; the application cache is bypassed.
limits: Do not infer replica lag without the routing/version evidence.
A read-your-write policy has latency/availability trade-offs that should be described, not prescribed universally.
verification_examples: Test a write followed by a routed read while observing primary and replica versions.
Verify the chosen consistency policy under a deliberately delayed replica.

evidence_interpretation_v1.0: Persists in cache invalidation as the cause after verified bypass and replica version evidence are clarified.
evidence_interpretation_v1.1: Notices an old version but does not connect it to the selected replica.
evidence_interpretation_v1.2: Connects routing and version lag to the stale result.
evidence_interpretation_v1.3: Explains why this evidence rules against the prior cache diagnosis and identifies a policy trade-off.
